title: engineering-radio-check-obs-ops-jun-15-2026
content:
Engineering radio check — Observability + Ops (notes, decisions, and action items)

Date: 2026-06-15
Facilitator: Aisha Kumar (obs lead)
Attendees: eng-observability, eng-sre, serving-runtime rep, release-eng, product-console liaison

Purpose: quick cross-org status for ongoing reliability work, unblockers before mid-quarter launch window, and sync on a low-latency rollout plan for model caching changes. This doc is intentionally light-weight — capture highlights, owners, and parking-lot items.

1) Quick scoreboard (last 7 days)
- Platform availability: 99.95% global for hosted inference control plane (goal: 99.99%). Degraded regions: eu-west had intermittent control-plane errors on 6/11 for ~45m.
- Error budget burn: ~0.04% used this week; most burn from transient control-plane 500s and a client-side SDK throttling misconfiguration.
- Latency (generation API) p95: 220ms (baseline target p95 <= 200ms); p99: 1.4s. Slight uptick correlated with longer sequence workloads on dedicated pools.
- Token throughput: Dedicated pools averaged 42M tokens/day (up 12% week-over-week).

2) Incidents & postmortems- eu-west control-plane flaps (2026-06-11) — Incident Commander: Jillian Park
  - Summary: partial outage for ~45m due to a misapplied routing rule during a canary rollout (automation race).
  - Impact: ~7% of hosted API traffic returned 500s or timed out for affected routes.
  - Root cause: race between rollout job and legacy routing-sync job; the new rule replaced a region fallback key before caches warmed.
  - Immediate mitigations applied: rollback of canary, manual flush of routing cache, throttle canary rollout.
  - Action items from war room: see action item list (below).

3) Current big initiatives (status summary)
- Model cache refactor (serving-runtime) — owner: Noah Singh
  - Goal: reduce cold-start token costs and improve p95 by moving prefix-KV to a persistent per-pod cache + LRU eviction tuned for burst traffic.
  - Status: integration tests passing in staging; early perf bench shows p95 improvement ~12% on 2 long-sequence workloads.
  - Risk: memory pressure on small-gpu instances. Mitigation: memory autoscale plugin and quantile-based eviction in next PR. Target prod canary: 2026-06-22.

- Observability storage compaction (eng-observability) — owner: Aisha Kumar
  - Goal: reduce costs and query tail latency by moving 30d cold metrics to compacted storage tier.
  - Status: design doc in review (confluence:obs-runbook-v2), compaction job prototype running nightly in staging.
  - Concern: dashboard drift — will require controlled migration and dashboard-side queries to default to hot tier for 7d.

- Release engineering: controlled rollout pipeline for model variants — owner: Mateo Rios
  - New pipeline adds per-route canary % and automatic rollback on AO (anomaly) signals from telemetry.
  - Status: pipeline implemented; needs observability hooks to signal regressions (JIRA-4967).

- Console per-route cost/latency UI (product-console) — owner: Evelyn Zhang
  - Status: feature flagged behind beta; UX ready, awaiting backend aggregation fix to surface p50/p95 correctly (linked PR).

4) Cross-team blockers and asks- Serving-runtime -> Observability: need a stable metrics name for KV-cache hits/misses. Blocking rollout canary since A/B will rely on the metric for automatic rollback. Owner: Noah -> action: add metric 'serving.kv_cache.evictions' by 2026-06-18.
- Release-eng -> SRE: require a post-deploy smoke-check that probes control-plane and a subset of routes. Owner: Mateo -> action: add smoke-check job to pipeline by 2026-06-20.
- Observability -> Console/product: historical queries returning partial results after compaction. Ask: product to accept 7d vs 30d default semantics in UI. Owner: Aisha/Evelyn -> decision needed by 2026-06-19.

5) Decisions made during sync
- Shorten canary window for routing changes from 60m to 20m with immediate health-check gating. Rationale: reduce blast radius and accelerate rollbacks on config-driven changes. Owner: Release Eng to enact pipeline change (Mateo).
- Rollout of persistent KV cache will use a staged rollout by dedicated cluster and only to nodes with >=32GB GPU host RAM. Rollout flag: kv-persist-enabled.

6) Action items (owner / due)
- (Noah) Add and publish stable KV cache metrics: 'serving.kv_cache.hits', 'serving.kv_cache.misses', 'serving.kv_cache.evictions' — due 2026-06-18
- (Jillian) Draft postmortem for eu-west control-plane incident and share for review — due 2026-06-17
- (Mateo) Implement smoke-check job and wire into release pipeline; add canary window change — due 2026-06-20
- (Aisha) Finalize compaction rollout plan and migration checklist; present plan to console/product — due 2026-06-19
- (Evelyn) Add UI toggles for 7d vs 30d metrics views; coordinate with obs for defaults — due 2026-06-19
- (Infra) Investigate memory autoscale plugin behavior on small-gpu fleets; report back — due 2026-06-21

7) Parking lot (topics to revisit)
- Standardizing alert severity taxonomy across regional controllers
- Long-tail latency profiling for embedding requests (p99.99 investigation)
- Playbook update: add step on cache warmup and fallback behavior to reduce canary race conditions

8) Quick wins proposed (low-effort)
- Enable an additional short-lived 'canary-probe' pod during routing rollouts that periodically queries golden routes (owner: SRE)
- Add a dashboard card with rollout % + active error budget per tenant (owner: Product + Observability)
- Temporarily increase logging level around routing-sync during deployments for 48h (owner: Release Eng)

9) Notes to self / informal items
- We should baseline p95 by workload class (chat vs long-generation) in the console so product teams can pick SLAs per-route.
- Consider a small synthetic workload generator that runs on each dedicated pool to surface node-level regressions.

10) Next sync
- Tentative: 2026-06-22 10:00 PT — focused on canary readiness and smoke-check results.

If you have follow-ups, add comments inline or ping Aisha/Jillian in #ops-alerts. This doc will be the source-of-truth for today's radio check; move items to Jira when owners accept.

End of notes.
